initial_prompt: What's the difference between crocodiles and alligators?

messages.content: What's the difference between crocodiles and alligators?

The easiest way to tell them apart is snout shape - alligators have wide, U-shaped snouts while crocodiles have longer, V-shaped snouts. Crocodiles also show their bottom teeth when their mouth is closed, while alligators don't. Crocodiles tend to be more aggressive and can tolerate saltwater, while alligators prefer freshwater.
